paragraphs: [Pesachim 113b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.113b.3) tells his story: Tuvia sinned, and Zigur came alone to testify against him before Rav Papa, who flogged Zigur. Zigur said to him, “Tuvia sinned, and Zigud is flogged?” Rav Papa replied, “Yes,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Rav Papa orders the lashes and answers the protest. The fuller linked account explains his objection to testimony by a lone witness.
The linked Pesachim reads Zigud throughout. Hyman uses Zigur and Zigud.
